solves.reason: (A) 'Many factors contribute to Americans' growing waistlines' — contribute(기여하다) 맞음. distribute(분배하다)는 의미 다름. (B) 'we are now confronted by huge portions' — confronted(직면한) 맞음. comforted(위안받은)는 반대. (C) 'ultimately can result in obesity' — ultimately(궁극적으로) 맞음. initially(처음에)는 반대. contribute-confronted-ultimately = ②.

(A) 'cannot be overlooked' — overlooked(간과됨) 맞음. overloaded(과부하)는 의미 다름. (B) 'perceived as normal' — perceived(인식됨) 맞음. deceived(속음)는 부적절. (C) 'consistently 250 percent larger' — consistently(일관되게) 맞음. inconsistently는 반대. overlooked-perceived-consistently = ①.

(A) 'The incidence of obesity' — incidence(발생률) 맞음. incident(사건)는 단수 사건. (B) 'large portion sizes are appropriate' — appropriate(적절한) 맞음. approximate(근사한)는 의미 다름. (C) 'people unintentionally consume more calories' — unintentionally(의도치 않게) 맞음. intentionally는 반대. incidence-appropriate-unintentionally = ④.
문맥상 부적절: ①increased — 비만 발생률 증가. 적절. ②coincidence — 우연의 일치 여부를 묻는 맥락. 적절. ③'correction' — 'environment of portion distortion'에서 distortion(왜곡) 맞음. correction(교정)은 반대 의미. 부적절 = ③. ④ultimately 적절.
문맥상 부적절: ①consume, ③steadily, ④offered 적절. ②'irregular' — 'jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger than the regular portions'에서 regular(일반) 맞음. irregular(불규칙한)는 의미 다름. 부적절 = ②.
문맥상 부적절: ②glasses, ③unintentionally, ④result 적절. ①'randomly' — 'jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger'에서 consistently(일관되게) 맞음. randomly(무작위로)는 반대. 부적절 = ①.
빈칸: 'The incidence of __________ has increased' — fullPassage: 'obesity'. ②obesity(비만) — 원문 일치. ①poverty, ③literacy, ④anxiety는 불일치. 정답 ②.
빈칸: 'environment of portion __________' — fullPassage: 'distortion'. ④distortion(왜곡) — 원문 일치. ①reduction, ②proportion, ③distribution은 불일치. 정답 ④.
빈칸: 'Is this just a __________' — fullPassage: 'coincidence'. ①coincidence(우연의 일치) — 원문 일치. ②consequence, ③confirmation, ④contradiction은 불일치. 정답 ①.
동의어: 밑줄 'overlooked' — 'cannot be overlooked'. overlooked = 간과됨. ①emphasized(강조됨), ③accepted, ④resolved는 불일치. ②ignored(무시됨) = 동의어. 정답 ②.
동의어: 밑줄 'confronted' — 'confronted by huge portions'. confronted = 직면한. ①faced(직면한) = 동의어. ②rewarded, ③delighted, ④satisfied는 불일치. 정답 ①.
동의어: 밑줄 'consume' — 'unintentionally consume more calories'. consume = 섭취하다. ①produce, ②preserve, ③distribute는 불일치. ④intake(섭취) = 동의어. 정답 ④.
반의어: 밑줄 'appropriate' — 'large portion sizes are appropriate'. appropriate = 적절한. 반의어 = unsuitable(부적절한). ①suitable, ②proper, ③fitting은 유의어. ④unsuitable — 반의어. 정답 ④.
반의어: 밑줄 'increased' — 'incidence of obesity has increased'. increased = 증가했다. 반의어 = diminished(감소했다). ①expanded, ③accumulated, ④multiplied는 유의어. ②diminished — 반의어. 정답 ②.

다의어: (A) 'factors contribute to Americans' growing waistlines' — contribute = 원인으로 작용하다(~에 기여하다). (B) 'contribute a large sum of money to the relief fund' — contribute = 기부하다. (A)원인으로 작용하다-(B)기부하다 = ③.

영영풀이: 'the act of changing the shape or truth of something so that it is no longer correct or accurate' = 형태나 진실을 왜곡하는 행위 = distortion(왜곡). ①proportion, ②perception, ③distortion — 정답. ④consumption은 불일치.
어형변환: '__________ (consist) 250 percent larger' — consist → consistently(부사, -ently 형태). 형용사 larger를 수식하는 부사. 정답: consistently.
어형변환: '__________ (intention) consume more calories' — intention → unintentionally. fullPassage에서 'unintentionally consume'. intention(명사) → un- + intentionally(부사). 정답: unintentionally.
빈칸 문맥: 'leads to __________ and ultimately can result in obesity' — fullPassage: 'weight gain'. ①weight gain — 원문 일치. ②weight loss, ③muscle growth, ④better health는 반대/불일치. 정답 ①.
빈칸 문맥: 'Americans have created the __________ that large portion sizes are appropriate' — fullPassage: 'the perception'. ④perception(인식) — 원문 일치. ①regulation, ②observation, ③coincidence는 불일치. 정답 ④.
